notes.title: October 2024 Patch Notes
notes.content:
We have a small patch for Starshifter this month, here's what changed:


 Jumping while sitting/laying down triggers the appropriate animation
 Graphic settings should now always be applied when the game starts
 Coyote's unlocked abilities won't carry over from save to save
 Howl puzzle notes are now visible in starsight
 Fixed a small UI bug when save files were deleted
 Rabbit now has correct text set when race is finished


If you run into any errors, please leave us a comment and we'll add them to our list! We're currently one programmer and one artist so we apologize for long waits between patches. If you've gotten a chance to play, any review helps with exposure and networking for our future projects!

notes.title: Patch Notes July 25th
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for a successful start to Starshifter, we're hoping you enjoy the game so far!

We've updated the build today with some bug fixes and changes, which you can see here:

Auto detect language at startup
Fix problems with Heron
Snowy trees in mountain don't interact with player anymore
Fix tumbleweed path in prairie
Fix bug where game could crash if you shifted before a transition
Fix bug where flowers could glitch underground
Coyote won't get stuck in geysers anymore
Frog enemies now have a timer on tongues
Frog boss has a bigger arena and the poison is slower
Fix some of the terrain in marsh/forest
All minigames should be stable now
Fix issue with owl race giving wrong records
Bison Guardian has a new texture
Laying down doesn't make foot steps anymore

Most notably, you should be able to 100% the game now as there should not be any more black screens after minigames. If you do find game breaking bugs though, please let us know and we'll work to fix them. Thanks again!

notes.title: Starshifter Update - Feb 28, 2023
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for supporting the release of Starshifter on Steam so far, we're so happy to see people trying out the game and giving us feedback on Steam and in our Discord!

We have an update today that addresses some of the most common concerns and bugs, here's what we've changed:

- cutscenes can be played without mouse prompts
- cutscenes won't skip camera cues sometimes
- cutscenes have some visual improvements for more coherency 
- added resolution options, vsync, fullscreen option, detail levels, fps counter
- added options to increase sensitivity and invert crow flight, as well as a pause control
- added a brief tutorial in the canyon level
- fixed problems where deer and fox quest could be done twice
- many fixes to navigation system
- fix controller issues on main menu
- control options now scrollable
- fix transparency issues with crow (maybe)
- fix issue with broken saves

We still have a lot of new content we aren't able to show yet, but we hope to make a larger content update around May, and more fixes and improvements in the meantime!

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Fpc4rsOakAEaw8X?format=jpg&name=medium
Coming soon...
